#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import ssl
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime

CERT = "/app/ssl/server.crt"
KEY = "/app/ssl/server.key"
PEM = "/app/ssl/server.pem"


def fail(msg):
    print("Certificate verification failed: " + msg)
    sys.exit(1)


def openssl(*args):
    return subprocess.run(
        ["openssl"] + list(args),
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True
    ).stdout


def main():
    for path in (CERT, KEY, PEM):
        if not os.path.isfile(path):
            fail("missing file " + path)

    try:
        ctx = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
        ctx.load_cert_chain(certfile=CERT, keyfile=KEY)
    except Exception as exc:
        fail("could not load certificate: " + exc)

    subject = openssl("x509", "-in", CERT, "-noout", "-subject").strip()
    enddate = openssl("x509", "-in", CERT, "-noout", "-enddate").strip()
    fingerprint = openssl("x509", "-in", CERT, "-noout", "-fingerprint", "-sha256").strip()

    cn = None
    for part in subject.replace("subject=", "").split(","):
        part = part.strip()
        if part.upper().startswith("CN=") or part.upper().startswith("CN ="):
            cn = part.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
            break
    if not cn:
        fail("Common Name not found")

    date_str = enddate.split("=", 1)[1].strip()
    expiry = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
    expiry_str = expiry.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    if expiry < datetime.now():
        fail("certificate has expired")

    print("Common Name: " + cn)
    print("Expiration Date: " + expiry_str)
    print("Subject: " + subject.replace("subject=", ""))
    print("Fingerprint: " + fingerprint.replace("sha256 Fingerprint=", ""))
    print("Certificate verification successful")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
